definitions.gloss: to demonstrate; to display; to exhibit
definitions.explanation: To bring out and show one's ability, power, or qualities effectively. Used when someone fully utilizes or manifests an inherent quality or capacity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発揮|はっき}する。
⟦チームワーク→チームワーク：10995_chiimuwaaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発揮|はっき}して⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: We won the game by demonstrating teamwork.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}していた→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{持|も}ち{前|まえ}→持ち前：22765_mochimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}→集中力：17614_shuuchuuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発揮|はっき}すること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was nervous, but during the actual performance I was able to display my natural concentration.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the quality being demonstrated. The subject brings out something they inherently possess — it is not used for acquiring new skills, but for making existing ones visible or effective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発揮|はっき}する (demonstrate one's ability)
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発揮|はっき}する (display one's talent)
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発揮|はっき}する (exert one's strength)
- ⟦リーダーシップ→リーダーシップ：09596_riidaashippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発揮|はっき}する (show leadership)
- ⟦{威力|いりょく}→威力：19611_iryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発揮|はっき}する (demonstrate power/effectiveness)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show — more general; can show things to others, not limited to inherent qualities
- ⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show/display — focuses on making something visible to others, while {発揮|はっき}する emphasizes bringing out latent ability
